notes: the chain runs to عائشة, the speaker of «قالت لما ثقل» (rule 6); occurrence 2 is «دخلت على عائشة», occurrence 1 is inside موسى بن أبي عائشة

second part: «فدخلت على ابن عباس فقلت ...» is a first-person encounter narrated by عبيد الله, with Ibn Abbas's words «قال هو علي»: whether Ibn Abbas is a source or only in the scene cannot be settled from the text, so he is not added (rules 6, 11)
